brands.description: Google Chrome is a freeware web browser developed by Google. brands.description: Microsoft PowerPoint is a slide show presentation program currently developed by Microsoft. PowerPoint initially named "Presenter", was created by Forethought Inc.. brands.name: Microsoft PowerPoint

brands.description: Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet developed by Microsoft for Windows, Mac OS X, and iOS. It features calculation, graphing tools, pivot tables, and a macro programming language called Visual Basic for Applications. It has been a very widely applied spreadsheet for these platforms, especially since version 5 in 1993, and it has replaced Lotus 1-2-3 as the industry standard for spreadsheets.
brands.name: Microsoft Excel

namedLocations.description: A ZIP Code is a postal code used by the United States Postal Service (USPS) in a system it introduced in 1963. The term ZIP is an acronym for Zone Improvement Plan; it was chosen to suggest that the mail travels more efficiently and quickly (zipping along) when senders use the code in the postal address. The basic format consists of five digits. An extended ZIP+4 code was introduced in 1983 which includes the five digits of the ZIP Code, followed by a hyphen and four additional digits that reference a more specific location.
namedLocations.name: ZIP Code

namedLocations.description: A letterhead is the heading at the top of a sheet of letter paper (stationery). That heading usually consists of a name and an address, and a logo or corporate design, and sometimes a background pattern. The term "letterhead" is often used to refer to the whole sheet imprinted with such a heading.
namedLocations.name: Letterhead

namedLocations.description: Ahmedabad (/ˈəhmədɑːbɑːd/ is the largest city and former capital of the Indian state of Gujarat. It is the administrative headquarters of the Ahmadabad district and the seat of the Gujarat High Court. Ahmedabad's population of 5,633,927 (as per 2011 population census) makes it the fifth-most populous city in India, and the encompassing urban agglomeration population estimated at 6,357,693 is the seventh-most populous in India. Ahmadabad is located on the banks of the Sabarmati River, 30 km (19 mi) from the state capital Gandhinagar, which is its twin city.
namedLocations.name: Ahmedabad

namedPeople.description: Busir or Bazir (Greek: Ibousiros Gliabanos, Busir Glavan; fl. 688–711) was the Khazar khagan in the late 7th century and early 8th century. In 704 Justinian II, who had been exiled at Chersonesos for nine years, arrived at Busir's court. Busir, perhaps seeking to use him in his political maneuverings with the Byzantine Empire, welcomed Justinian and gave him his sister in marriage (the woman's Khazar name is unknown, but she took the baptismal name of Theodora.) Busir provided the couple with funds and a house in Phanagoria.

transcript.text: Welcome to Onprint Shop At Onprint Shop, we are continuously evolving our solution capabilities to help you deliver the best services to your customers and grow your online business.
We are releasing Onprint Shop version 7.0 with major technology upgrades, PHP and Bootstrap that includes new feature and enhancements to meet the changing requirement of our clients.
In this video we will see the storefront features.
These are the list of major upgrades for storefronts.
So let's see very first feature that is product header menu option Mega menu.
This feature will give you flexibility to display all products in better way.
It will combine all categories products and display your products in mega menu for easy browsing.
So end client will be able to have a glance of your complete product offering under this menu.
In the back end you have to change the setting 1st to go into the store personalization and go to the link header and footer.
Here is the product action.
Add it and change the type as a mega menu and also you can change as all group and category and all category and products.
For now, let's choose this mega menu and save it.
Now when we go to the storefront and refresh mega menu.
So this is the mega menu feature available so where your client will be able to see the complete products you are offering.
Next feature is Grade view for order listing page.
This feature has enhanced visibility of orders in customer My account section on the storefront.
Go to the My Account and order section.
Here they will have two option grade and listing.
It is grade view and this is listing page.
So by this view they will have better visibility of number of orders they have placed in my account.
Next feature is Price calculator page optimization performance and present.
This option has simplify the calculator where now calculator is divided in print estimator and shipping estimator.
By default shipping estimator will be by default collapse.
So user can get instant price estimation without waiting to get shipping estimate which often takes long time as it may be coming from third party shipping like UPX, Feldex etc.
And client will also have an option to open estimator to calculate the shipping estimate as well.
You know it is the collapse option is available.
This setting can be enabled or disabled from the admin panel store configuration setting.
Next feature is Multiple quantity option products setting based.
This feature is specially designed to simplify print ordering estimation for promotion products such as T-shirt caps where you offer multiple sizes within product, for example T-shirt.

Now client can select the T-shirt as a product and put the separate quantity for each size like small, medium, large, extra large and will also append the stock if you are managing the stock for each size.
Separate quantity for each size and customer will get the estimated pricing.
Over here it is the product based setting in the back end.
When I go to the product action and setting it can be enable or disable product based multiple quantity input yes or no.
As soon as I click on yes and save, default quantity option will be height and into the addition options new price with multiplication text.

New addition option can be added like Small size, medium size, large size and extra large and it will be available for your customer to put the separate quantity for each size like small, medium, large and extra large and they will get the estimated pricing.
Next feature is sidebar removed from pages that appear after product info page.
This is to improve the look and feel experience as by defaults side panel is disable from the all pages after product info page.
So user will not have districted by other links in side panel.
By default side panel will be disabled but for admin there is a provision if you want to enable it in the back end store Personalization Sidebar management.
Admin can go over here and enable or disable left sidebar or right sidebar for any pages.
Next feature is option image All text added to help giving a boost to the SEO efforts.
This option is introduced keeping in the mind the all text is added so that SEO effort is made effective.
The alt text will be available for the product category and banner image.
So you can put alt text for each image which will be read by SEO and display the result if end client searches in search engine with matching keywords.
When we go to the admin panel and go to the SEO image alt text, here is the product page editor view button.
When we click on that and see the all keywords can be managed for each product image.
Similarly it is for category banner images.
So these were major upgrades for storefronts and these are the minor enhancement.
Very first one is shipping method based on discount.
Now admin user can also create the discount from discounts coupon for complete shipping method like weight based, quantity based, FedEx, UPS etc.
It makes easy for admin to manage to calculate the shipping price based on complete shipping method in the back end coupon and discount.
When I go to the action and add it, here is the discount on product price and shipping price, shipping price, shipping type.
So earlier we had an option to create the discount for this shipping types only.
But now we have an option for shipping method, entire shipping method like weight based UPS etc.
Next feature is schema.org enhancement product and website tech optimization for SEO purpose.
It is nothing to do from the admin panel.
Already our developer had improved this schema.org enhancement in the back end source code.
So it will get help for your end users to get the proper search is results when they search in the search engine.
Next feature is pricing page optimization.
The pricing page has been optimized and works faster than before even if a lot of products are listed there.
Next feature is tracking link on order listing page.
Currently the tracking link is available only on order detail page.
But now it will be available at both the order listing as well as the order detail page.
When I go to the storefront, go to the My account and order section, it is the track order in the order list and this is order detail.
Next feature is Extra filled drop down.
This feature is for when we create the extra filled for customer registration form, the select option label will be appear.
Select option label appears for mandatory extra filled drop down to get customers attention to make sure that they choose the drop down option before click on submit like that user type.
So now we have done the major and minor enhancement which we have done for Storefront.
If you have any query concern, please feel free to write us at support@onprintshop.com and share your feedbacks and suggestions.
We will add them in suggestions for our upcoming versions.
Thanks for your time, have a great day.
